rows.appln_abstract: The silicon carbide guide cylinder for the water pump comprises a guide cylinder body, a guide lantern ring is fixedly connected to the outer side wall of the guide cylinder body in a sleeved mode, an auxiliary cylinder is fixedly connected into the guide cylinder body in a sleeved mode, and an auxiliary lantern ring is fixedly connected to the outer side wall of the auxiliary cylinder in a sleeved mode. The top edge of the flow guide lantern ring is fixedly connected with an auxiliary lantern ring through reinforcing ribs, and the inner wall of the flow guide cylinder body is connected with a reinforcing assembly. According to the utility model, the scouring force of the guide cylinder body is increased through the wear-resistant layer, the strength of the guide cylinder body is doubly enhanced through the filling layer and the damping cotton, and then the strength of the guide cylinder body is enhanced again through the foam block and the fiber layer, so that the wear of the guide cylinder is reduced, and the direction of water can be guided; the service life of the flow barrel body is prolonged, and the use effect is improved.

An apparatus for providing synchronized navigation may include a processor. The processor may be configured to provide for concurrent display of information related to a space dimension on a background layer and information related to a linear dimension on a foreground layer, wherein the foreground layer is provided as an overlay over at least a portion of the background layer. The processor may be additionally configured to provide for synchronized navigation of the foreground layer and the background layer. Associated methods and computer program products may also be provided.

The invention belongs to the technical field of VOC, and discloses a VOC on-line data intelligent analyzer. The bottom of a housing of the VOC on-line data intelligent analyzer is provided with a protective frame; the bottom of the protective frame is provided with travelling wheels; the internal bodies of the two sides of the protective frame are provided with stress spring symmetrically; the external wall of each buffer rubber plate is pressed against the external wall of the housing of the VOC on-line data intelligent analyzer; the two sides of a gas inlet pipe are connected with an inlet pipe of gas to be detected and a zero gas input pipe respectively. The VOC on-line data intelligent analyzer is compact in structure, and is convenient to move; cooperation of the protective frame and the buffer rubber plates is capable of protecting the VOC on-line data intelligent analyzer from damages caused by collision ; real time monitoring and alarming are realized via statistical processing of data collected by a sensor set and comparison of the data with standard values; and a communication unit is used for sending processed data to mobile equipment and remote terminals, so that it is convenient for query and contrast.

The invention relates to a Chinese medicine prescription for conditioning of phlegm-dampness constitution metabolic syndrome. The components of the Chinese medicine prescription are prepared from the following Chinese medicines of, by weight, citrus grandis tomentosa, tuckahoe, yam, raw adlay, fructus perillae, semen raphani, seaweed, raw hawthorn, radix puerariae, sophora japonica and lotus leaves. According to the Chinese medicine prescription, through the scientific components, experimental research and number of years of clinical use, the therapeutic effect is verified. The Chinese medicine prescription has a very good therapeutic effect on phlegm-dampness constitution metabolic syndrome, and the clinical symptoms of metabolic syndrome patients can be effectively improved.

The utility model discloses water feeding equipment of stacked broiler breeding equipment, which comprises a base and a stacked breeding frame, two ends of the upper surface of the base are respectively and fixedly connected with a water storage tank and a water pump through bolts, the upper surface of the water storage tank is connected with a water inlet pipe, and one end of the water storage tank is fixedly connected with a sealing cover through a screw. A sliding frame is fixedly connected to the interior of the water storage tank through bolts, a filter screen is slidably mounted on the upper side of the sliding frame, one end of the filter screen is fixedly connected with the sealing cover through screws, and a quartz sand filter layer and an activated carbon filter layer are sequentially arranged in the filter screen from inside to outside; through the filter screen, the quartz sand filter layer, the activated carbon filter layer and the sliding frame, when the water feeding equipment is used, a water source is stored through the water storage tank, water can be filtered through the filter screen, the quartz sand filter layer and the activated carbon filter layer, and therefore the situation that a water pump is damaged due to the fact that foreign matter exists in the supplemented water source is prevented; or the broiler chickens eat the broiler chickens to cause problems.

PURPOSE:To rebound the splashing soil with the force restoring the elastic deformation to smoothen the soil crushing and the soil throwing backward and prevent soil sticking satisfactorily by giving a tension to the elastic cover covering the tilling part A by means of a plate spring. CONSTITUTION:Attachments 6, 9 and 15 are fitted to the frame 7 of the rotary tiller, and the elastic cover 24 covering the tilling part A is fixed to these attachments on one side from the front to the rear. The elastic cover 24 is provided with a stitching material 28 on the other side and an energizing mechanism 27 is set between the fixed side containing the attachments 6, 9, and 15 and the stitching material 28 to give a tension to the elastic cover 24. Further, the energizing mechanism 27 is equipped with a plate spring 31 set between the stitching part 20 and the attachments so that the spring 31 curves upward and a tension adjuster 38 which is set on the supporting side and adjust the curvature of the spring 31. Since the elastic cover 24 covering the tilling part is energized with the mechanism 27, the splashing soil is rebounded by the restoring force of the cover, thus soils are effectively crushed and sent backward. In addition, the sticking soil can be surely detached from the machine.

The invention discloses a novel Beijing opera fiddle cylinder which includes a cylinder body, a python skin assembly and buffering suites. The python skin assembly includes a python skin, a connecting cylinder, and a hold hoop. The python skin is secured to the connecting cylinder through the hold hoop. The connecting cylinder and the cylinder body are in detachable sealing connection. Each set of buffering suites includes one rubber sleeve and one foam sleeve. The foam sleeve sleeves the outside of the rubber sleeve. The cylinder body and the connecting cylinder are joined in spiral engagement. According to the invention, the novel Beijing opera fiddle cylinder, by introducing the buffering suites, makes a player more comfortable in usage, is anti-slippery and has detachable and exchangeable python skin.

PURPOSE:To prevent internal short caused by charge performed after overdischarge by specifying the area of a positive plate whose grid bones are not exposed on the surface of the plate to 60% or more against the total area of the plate. CONSTITUTION:A positive plate is formed in such a way that a center grid part is made thiner than the other grid part and paste 3 comprising lead oxide and dilute sulfuric acid is filled in the grid. A negative plate is formed by filling paste comprising lead oxide, dilute sulfuric acid, barrium sulfate, and others on the usual grid. In a sealed lead-acid battery having a plate distance of 0.5- 1mm. and an electrolyte volume of 5-10cc per 1Ah of 10hr rate, a non-exposed part area E of the grid bone of a positive plate is specified to 60% or more to prevent short. By specifying non-exposed part area like this, internal short caused by charge performed after overdischarge can be prevented.

The invention relates to the use of angiotensin II in combination with angiotesin 1-9 to potentiate angiotensin II activity. The invention also relates to the use of combinations of angiotensin II and angiotensin 1-9 to increase vasoconstriction and to treat disorders associated with low blood pressure.

An integrated circuit (IC) device comprises an array comprising rows and columns of conductive interconnect pads. At least one optical alignment fiducial region is distinct from the array and comprises a fiducial pattern, wherein the fiducial pattern comprises a first group of pads contiguous to a second group of pads, and wherein a width of a space between nearest pads of the first and second groups is wider than the spaces between pads within each group.
